# Exercício 1
##Reproduzir os exemplos do enunciado do livro
```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins)
 
 ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)
)

ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)
) +
  geom_point()
#> Warning: Removed 2 rows containing missing values (`geom_point()`).

ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)
) +
  geom_point()
  
  ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
  
  ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)
) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
  
  ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)
) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
  
  ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Body mass and flipper length",
    subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
    x = "Flipper length (mm)", y = "Body mass (g)",
    color = "Species", shape = "Species"
  ) +
  scale_color_colorblind()
```

## Questão 3 
```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm)
) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

### As variaveis se relacionam de forma correlacional
```

## Questão 4
```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = species)
) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

#Os pontos se alinham, de forma que fica impossivel inferir sobre os dados.Geom_boxplot pode ser uma opção melhor.

ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = species)
) +
  geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

# Exercicio 3
```{r}
library(gt)
data("anscombe")
gt(anscombe, rownames_to_stub = TRUE) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Quarteto de Anscombe")

library(ggplot2)
anscombe %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = anscombe, aes(x = x1, y = y1)) +
  geom_smooth(data = anscombe, aes(x = x1, y = y1), method = "lm", color = "Red", se = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Conjunto 1")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = anscombe, aes(x = x2, y = y2)) +
  geom_smooth(data = anscombe, aes(x = x2, y = y2), method = "lm", color = "Red", se = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Conjunto 2")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = anscombe, aes(x = x3, y = y3)) +
  geom_smooth(data = anscombe, aes(x = x3, y = y3), method = "lm", color = "Red", se = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Conjunto 3")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = anscombe, aes(x = x4, y = y4)) +
  geom_smooth(data = anscombe, aes(x = x4, y = y4), method = "lm", color = "Red", se = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Conjunto 4")
```
